The best chain on garnet is QB7-QB12-QB11. I read it from the current default calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade, which has 28 CZ pairs, and every pair has an IRB value. The IRB CZ fidelity of QB7-QB12 is 0.998016 and of QB12-QB11 is 0.998693. Their product is 0.996712. The runner-up chain is QB12-QB11-QB16 with a product of 0.994689.

I ran a 3-qubit GHZ circuit on garnet:mock with 200 shots, as job 01a15fa0-a3c6-7377-b013-4b6fff367c67, and it completed. The circuit uses only native gates. It applies RY(pi/2) to all three qubits, then CZ on QB7-QB12 and CZ on QB12-QB11, then RY(-pi/2) to QB7 and QB11. It measures QB7, QB12 and QB11 under one key, in that order. The counts are 000: 56, 001: 50, 110: 40 and 111: 54.

The mock returns random results, so these counts do not show a GHZ state. The script crashed on a client API mismatch after it submitted the job. I fetched that same job's results without submitting it again. Scripts are in /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-35/scratch/.
